text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High error-rate spike observed in hosted inference cluster eu-west-1. 5xxs increasing since ~3m ago, P50 latency rising. Auto-detect: routing congestion on t2 pool. Paging oncall group: @sara (oncall)

sara (oncall): saw the pager. joining. can you dump the head metrics?

ops-bot: metrics snapshot: 
- 10m error rate: 3.9% (baseline 0.1%)
- p50 latency: 520ms (baseline 120ms)
- active connections: 18k (t2 pool)
- queue length: 7.2k

mike (infra): looks like tail of cold starts + uneven routing. t2 GPU nodes saturated in eu-west-1. New nodes are healthy but autoscaler slow.

lee (sre): any customers impacted? status page?

ops-bot: partial customer impact detected: elevated latencies for standard-tier and free-tier; enterprise-tier traffic routed to dedicated pools unaffected. No large errors for embeddings endpoints.

tara (product): customer-reported slowdowns in EU support channel, a few timed out requests. Need a mitigation that minimizes cost/regressions.

alex (eng-runtime): proposing temporary smart-routing change: steer standard-tier requests away from t2 to t1-fallback (slightly higher latency but far more available) and apply short-lived rate-limit for free-tier. Also disable non-critical streaming to reduce active connections.

sara (oncall): do it. Prioritize minimizing enterprise impact. steps?

mike (infra): I can apply an override routing policy. snippet:

```
# temporary policy id: mitigation-1779005
match: request.tier in ["free", "standard"] and region == "eu-west-1"
action:
  - prefer_backends: ["t1-fallback-eu", "t0-burst-global"]
  - max_qps: 2500   # global cap for free+standard in eu-west
  - disable_feature: ["streaming_non_enterprise"]
ttl: 00:30:00
```

mike (infra): applying now...

ops-bot: routing policy mitigation-1779005 applied (preview -> active).

lee (sre): monitoring. set alert if p95 > 1.5s or error-rate > 1% for more than 2m.

sara (oncall): also put a per-customer soft quota for free-tier to avoid noisy neighbors. 100 req/min per org. mike can you add quota?

mike (infra): adding quota override: 
```
quota.override("free") {
  requests_per_minute = 100
  enforcement = "soft"
  ttl = 00:30:00
}
```
applied.

alex (eng-runtime): disabling non-enterprise streaming hook across eu clusters: command run. This will turn streaming responses into buffered non-streaming for affected requests.

ops-bot: streaming feature toggle: disabled for non-enterprise in eu-west-1.

tara (product): heads-up: this will change client behaviour for some customers. we've posted to status and DM'd known impacted accounts.

sara (oncall): what's telemetry look like 2m after mitigation?

ops-bot: t+2m post-mitigation snapshot: 
- 10m error rate: 0.9%
- p50 latency: 260ms
- p95 latency: 880ms (down from 1.8s)
- active connections: 9k

lee (sre): improvement visible. keep mitigation for another 15m and then gradually roll back if stable.

mike (infra): autoscaler still catching up; I've increased scale target and warm pool by +20% for eu-west-1.

alex (eng-runtime): also enabled prefix KV caching bump for standard-tier on eu-west to reduce repeated model hotstarts.

ops-bot: cache bump in effect.

tara (product): I'll coordinate with support to collect any customer impact notes and send a CSAT follow-up if needed.

sara (oncall): logging decisions for postmortem: mitigation policy applied (mitigation-1779005), free-tier quota soft cap, disabled non-enterprise streaming, increased autoscaler warm pool, KV cache bump. Owner: sara.

lee (sre): tagging alerts and tracing for an eval run: we'll run a regression check against canary prompt set after rollback.

mike (infra): planning rollback timeline: at t+20m start ramp down of routing policy weight over 5m, then re-enable streaming, then remove quota override.

ops-bot: at t+10m metrics stable. p95 < 1s and error-rate < 0.5%.

sara (oncall): ok start gradual rollback now. mike begin weight ramp to normal.

mike (infra): rolling weight back: 50% -> 80% -> 100% over 5m.

ops-bot: 60s check: p95 420ms, error-rate 0.3%.

alex (eng-runtime): re-enabling streaming for non-enterprise in eu-west (canary 10% first).

ops-bot: streaming canary 10%: no anomalies in 60s.

mike (infra): removing free-tier quota override. removed.

ops-bot: routing policy mitigation-1779005 removed, feature toggles restored, autoscaler left at +10% warm pool for 30m.

lee (sre): incident resolved from operational standpoint. we'll create full incident writeup with timelines and root-cause analysis. early hypothesis: transient routing imbalance plus slow autoscaler and heavy free-tier streaming increased connection counts leading to t2 pool saturation.

tara (product): post-incident action items: tighten autoscaler responsiveness thresholds, add preemptive streaming throttles for free-tier, improve routing policy automatic failover thresholds.

sara (oncall): thanks team. I'll open the postmortem and assign follow-ups. leaving oncall to mike for next 30m oversight.

mike (infra): ack. I'll monitor and update if anything else pops up.

incident-bot: incident closed (operationally mitigated). Full report assigned to sara; follow-ups: autoscaler tuning (mike), streaming throttles (alex/tara), routing failover thresholds (lee). :white_check_mark:
